{"key":"req-0001","model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","response":{"candidates":[{"index":0,"content":{"parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  \n  // Standard Restart Checks\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n  \n  // Stable Mode (Reluctant Doubling)\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Focused Mode: Asymmetric VDAR with Quadratic Protection\n  \n  // Static state variables to maintain VDAR history\n  // Note: Using static variables as per instructions to not modify solver struct.\n  // Assumes sequential usage or single solver instance.\n  static double v_global = 0.0;\n  static uint64_t last_check_conflicts = 0;\n  static uint64_t last_check_props = 0;\n  static uint64_t last_real_restart_conflicts = 0;\n  static bool initialized = false;\n\n  // Detect solver reset or new instance (heuristic reset)\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c last_check_conflicts) {\n      initialized = false;\n      last_check_conflicts = 0;\n      last_check_props = 0;\n      last_real_restart_conflicts = 0;\n      v_global = 0.0;\n  }\n\n  const uint64_t current_conflicts = CONFLICTS;\n  const uint64_t current_props = GET (propagations);\n\n  // Step 1: Calculate 'Learning Velocity' (V_local)\n  // Ratio of newly generated conflicts to executed propagations since last check\n  uint64_t delta_conf = current_conflicts - last_check_conflicts;\n  uint64_t delta_props = current_props - last_check_props;\n  \n  // Update state for next check\n  last_check_conflicts = current_conflicts;\n  last_check_props = current_props;\n\n  double v_local = 0.0;\n  if (delta_props \u003e 0) {\n      v_local = (double)delta_conf / (double)delta_props;\n  }\n\n  // Step 2: Update Global EMA (V_global)\n  // Smoothing factor alpha = 0.05\n  if (!initialized) {\n      v_global = v_local;\n      initialized = true;\n  } else {\n      v_global = 0.95 * v_global + 0.05 * v_local;\n  }\n\n  // Step 3: Compute 'Reluctance Factor' (R)\n  double R;\n  if (v_local \u003e v_global) {\n      // Solver is finding conflicts faster than average\n      R = 1.0 + 2.0 * (v_local - last_real_restart_conflicts) \u003c 100) {\n          return false;\n      }\n      // Condition: fast \u003e slow * threshold * (R * R)\n      limit = slow * margin * (R * R);\n  } else {\n      // Stagnation: Linear scaling\n      // Condition: fast \u003e slow * threshold * R\n      limit = slow * margin * R;\n  }\n\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"VDAR: v_loc=%.4f v_glob=%.4f R=%.2f limit=%.2f fast=%.2f\",\n                            v_local, v_global, R, limit, fast);\n\n  // Check trigger condition (limit \u003c= fast implies fast is too high relative to limit)\n  bool restart = (limit \u003c= fast);\n\n  if (restart) {\n      last_real_restart_conflicts = current_conflicts;\n  }\n\n  return restart;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"finishReason":"STOP"}],"responseId":"orGFaYrcDpnPqtsPh8uyiQ0","usageMetadata":{"thoughtsTokenCount":6511,"totalTokenCount":13535,"candidatesTokenCount":1112,"promptTokenCount":5912,"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":5912,"modality":"TEXT"}]},"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview"}}
